extension.summary: Lean enhancements for Estuary MOD V2
extension.description: A small, non-destructive set of enhancements for skin.estuary.modv2 (Estuary MOD V2), built fresh against the Omega release. Reorders the gear Settings menu so Skin Settings sits above Media sources, and adds a dedicated "Tony.7.Bones MOD V2+" Skin Settings category that is home to our tweaks. The System Info overlay is hidden by default (toggle renamed "Disable System Info overlay"), the top-bar weather icons default to the Outline HD set (resource.images.weathericons.outline-hd), and the clock and navigation wordmark each have a per-item toggle that defaults to the stock look. The category also carries in-tab Apply and Restore buttons. Run after installing or updating skin.estuary.modv2. Apply and Restore are both available — original files are backed up once and never overwritten, and Restore reverts every change cleanly.
extension.news: Outline HD weather icons now apply to the home weather widget too (Apply sets MOD V2's WeatherIcons skin strings, not just the top bar). Restore now asks for confirmation first.
